response.overview: Darkroom is a city symphony and filmed diary that captures the invisible pulse of Buenos Aires through a visual, introspective journey. The film opens on the vastness of the Río de la Plata before venturing deep into the heart of the city, culminating in an intimate portrait of local neighbours in a Buenos Aires quarter. Eschewing traditional narrative, the work observes the tension between the river landscape and everyday life, transforming the ordinary into a poetic visual essay on porteño identity and the memory of its streets.
response.title: Darkroom
